sceneDescription: JOKE: Shopify's AI lets you build an online store just by chatting—so the punchline is literally 'building a store' out of chat bubbles. The scene is a glass-walled meeting room where a whiteboard is covered not with marker notes but with 3D plastic 'chat bubble' fridge magnets, some stacked up to form the outline of a storefront. No people. The humor comes from the absurd literalness of constructing a store out of chat bubbles, riffing on the story's 'build store by chatting with AI' claim.
finalImagePrompt: A corporate meeting room with a large whiteboard taking up most of one wall. On the whiteboard, instead of drawn plans, there are dozens of colorful plastic chat bubble magnets arranged to form the outline of a shopfront—door, windows, even a little awning. The table beneath holds scattered dry-erase markers and a mug. The room is empty, natural daylight filtering in, and everything else looks perfectly normal.
